confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on crowdsourced Numbeo-derived Kotor and Montenegro aggregates plus a few travel-guide ranges, adjusted up for July peak season. Beer is reasonably supported. Cocktail rests on a single espresso martini listing, and wine on a tasting-flight price and a bottle-starting-price guide, so both are weak. Wine glass is inferred from those figures and the local beer relationship. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate; no live listings or booking pages were checked. EUR to USD uses an assumed rate of about 1.16 that was not sourced. The FX observation comes from search-result text describing the RBA exchange-rates page, not from a page I opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Euro-priced Adriatic coastal tourist town. Food and drink are based on Montenegro-wide aggregates and Budva seafront figures, adjusted to Kotor's Numbeo-reported levels. Accommodation is benchmarked holistically against Adriatic coastal tourist towns in peak season.
